pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-02.png with Read and looked at it directly. It read without problems. The page has 4 panels: a wide top panel, a middle row with left and right panels, and a wide bottom panel. There are teal label boxes in addition to the caption and balloons.
pages.observation: My reading order: (1) Top panel. Caption 'The clinic begins its Welbuk onboarding.' at top left, then the teal label 'WELBUK PRACTICE for the clinic' at top right. Ananya is present. (2) Middle-left panel. 'We can organise our clinic workflow here.' The tail points to Ananya. (3) Middle-right panel. 'And our team can use tools suited to each staff role.' The tail points to Meera, followed by the teal label 'WELBUK CARE for clinic staff'. (4) Bottom panel. 'One team. Better coordination.' with a very short tail to Ananya, and Meera on the right. Issues: (a) The jump from page 1's 'Let's make the rest simpler' straight to 'onboarding' feels abrupt. Who chose Welbuk, and when, is not shown, and 'Welbuk' is introduced only through labels. (b) 'Here' in panel 2 has no visible referent (screen, tablet or desk). The storyboard should indicate a device or screen. (c) The panel 4 balloon sits on top of Ananya's placeholder label, and its tail is so short that the speaker could be misread as Meera, who stands to the right of the balloon. (d) The top-left caption and top-right label sit on or past the panel frame edges. (e) Panel 4 is large but has no new beat beyond a slogan, so the page ends on a tagline rather than a reaction.
